name: Bond

components.pose: She stands with a bold, delighted smile before the great dragon, one hand raised and gently resting her palm against its snout, her other hand relaxed at her side, her face turned toward the camera with wonder and quiet certainty; the dragon's head is lowered to her and its eyes are on her; both are fully in frame.
components.effects: A thread of {{MAGIC}} light runs from her palm to the dragon's brow where they touch, the bond forming, motes of light rising between them, heat shimmering and embers drifting up around both of them.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Pyraxis, an Elder Dragon of flame-red and burnished-gold scales, wreathed in heat haze, wings like sheets of molten bronze, towering close beside her and lowering its great head toward her raised hand, its eyes fixed on her

notes: BOND: the first meeting with her Elder Dragon in its lair, her palm against its snout as the bond forms.
